tools.name: check_renewal_compliance
tools.description: Score a subscription business's signup/cancellation flow against current US click-to-cancel / automatic-renewal laws (federal FTC Section 5/ROSCA, plus CA/CO/VT/OR in the full paid report). Deterministic rules engine, no LLM guessing -- every finding cites its actual statute. This free tool returns only the federal result plus a locked count of state findings; the full 5-jurisdiction report with citations is a $49 one-time purchase at renewalmatrix.vercel.app. Informational only, not legal advice.

sells_states.description: State codes the business sells subscriptions in, e.g. ['CA','CO'], or ['nationwide']

online_signup.description: Can a customer sign up online? (default true)

online_cancel.description: Can a customer cancel online, same medium as signup?

phone_or_email_required.description: Is phone or email required to cancel?

prechecked_consent.description: Is the auto-renew consent box pre-checked/default-on?

renewal_notice_days.description: Days of advance notice sent before a renewal charge, if any

long_term_or_discounted_trial.description: Is this a 1+ year term or a discounted-trial-to-paid conversion?

confirmation_email_with_cancel_instructi.description: Does the signup confirmation email restate cancel instructions?

b2b_customers_colorado.description: Does the business sell to B2B customers in Colorado?
